blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **выводить → выводит** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.
**развеселить → развеселит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**позаниматься → позанимаюсь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Look away for a minute! I'm going to quickly change my clothes.
exercises.why: **переодеться → переоденусь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

**поесть → поедим** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.prompt: "Is it fine to change the channel?" "Mm, yeah."
exercises.why: **переключить → переключу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**побриться → побреюсь** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**оценить → Оцените** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

**выехать → выедем** — perfective verb, 1st person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future. Давай — one person (ты); Давайте — several people, or one person by вы; the verb is the same.

exercises.q: Сруби это усохшее дерево, а иначе оно ___ (упасть) на твой дом.
exercises.prompt: Cut down that dead tree, or it will fall down on your house.
exercises.why: **упасть → упадёт** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**свести → сведёте** — perfective verb, 2nd person plural: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Old birds are not caught with chaff.
exercises.why: **поймать → поймаешь** — perfective verb, 2nd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**найтись → найдётся** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**подать → подам** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**выбрать → выберу** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.q: Я не думаю, что сегодня вечером у нас ___ (получиться) потусить.
exercises.prompt: I don't think that we'll be able to hang out together tonight.
exercises.why: **получиться → получится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**заменить → заменит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
**прослужить → прослужит** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Okay, okay, I'll think about it.
exercises.why: **подумать → подумаю** — perfective verb, 1st person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.

exercises.prompt: Wait for the tea to brew.
exercises.why: **завариться → заварится** — perfective verb, 3rd person singular: it has no present tense; the present-type ending gives the future.
